title: Regularizing Treatment Leakage for LLM-based Uplift Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Uplift modeling estimates the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) and supports industrial decisions such as promotional pricing. When large language models (LLMs) encode product text, treatment-revealing content can introduce shortcuts that do not transfer to deployment. We propose \emph{LLM-based Uplift Leakage Regularization} (\textsc{LULR}), which uses a CLUB-based penalty on the causal head's trainable shared representation while keeping the LLM encoder frozen. Controlled proxy experiments show a positive ranking-score interaction and higher scores than the tested weight-decay configuration; treatment-dependent evaluation limits their interpretation to exploratory model behavior. Structured-only comparisons provide reference performance, without establishing a general advantage over tree-based estimators. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的提升估计中的处理信息泄漏正则化
translated_abstract: 提升建模用于估计条件平均处理效应（CATE），并可支持促销定价等工业决策。当大语言模型（LLM）对产品文本进行编码时，暴露处理信息的内容可能引入无法迁移到实际部署阶段的捷径。我们提出了基于LLM的提升泄漏正则化方法（LULR），该方法在保持LLM编码器冻结的前提下，对因果头的可训练共享表示施加基于CLUB的惩罚项。受控代理实验显示出正的排序分数交互效应，且得分高于所测试的权重衰减配置；依赖处理的评估使其解释仅限于探索性的模型行为。仅使用结构化特征的对比提供了参考性能，但并未确立相对基于树的估计器的普遍优势。在一项包含百万条记录的工业定价随机对照试验（RCT）上，LULR在5个随机种子中的4个上改进了离线lift@0.3指标，尽管（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出LULR方法，通过在冻结LLM编码器的同时对因果头共享表示施加基于CLUB的互信息惩罚，抑制LLM编码文本中泄露处理信息的捷径，从而改进工业定价RCT场景下的CATE提升估计效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LULR, which regularizes treatment leakage in LLM-based uplift estimation by applying a CLUB-based mutual information penalty to the causal head's shared representation while keeping the LLM encoder frozen, improving offline lift@0.3 on a million-record industrial pricing RCT.
